# RiskCalc — Full Content Index

> Prop-firm & SMC risk management calculator. Compute exact position size for indices, crypto, forex, and commodities — designed for prop firm, SMC, and ICT traders. Know your exact size before you click buy.

RiskCalc (prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app) is a position-size and risk-management calculator for prop firm, SMC, and ICT traders. It converts risk percentage, account balance, entry price, and stop-loss into an exact position size in contracts, lots, or units — across major indices, crypto, forex, and gold.

## Site Structure

- Homepage (`/`): category overview and featured market calculators.
- Calculator pages (`/calculator/:slug`): 8 market-specific pages, each with H1, SEO intro, focus keywords, and the live position-size calculator.
- Featured pages (promoted first): Nasdaq 100 (NQ), Micro Nasdaq 100 (MNQ), Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Gold (XAU/USD), EUR/USD.
- Risk Management FAQ on the homepage.

## Core Use Cases

- Calculate exact position size from risk %, account balance, entry, and stop-loss
- Size positions for prop firm evaluations and funded accounts
- Preview risk-to-reward ratio with an optional take-profit level
- Size trades on indices (NQ, MNQ, ES, US30), crypto (BTC, ETH), forex (EUR/USD), and gold (XAU/USD)
- Follow SMC/ICT risk management rules with precise contract math
- Understand contract specifications per market (tick value, pip size, price precision, position unit)

## How Position Sizing Works

The calculator uses each market's contract specifications to convert your dollar risk into an exact position size:

1. Dollar risk = account balance × risk percentage.
2. Stop distance in price = entry price − stop-loss.
3. Position size = dollar risk ÷ (stop distance × tick value).

For forex pairs, the stop distance is converted from price into pips using the pip size before the division. Output is expressed in the market's native position unit (contracts, coins, or lots). An optional take-profit lets you preview the risk-to-reward (R:R) ratio.

### Nasdaq 100 (NQ) Position Size Calculator
- URL: https://prop-firm-risk-calculator.vercel.app/calculator/nq-nasdaq
- Title: NQ Position Size Calculator for Prop Firms — Nasdaq 100 Risk Calculator
- H1: Nasdaq 100 (NQ) Position Size Calculator
- Description: Calculate your exact NQ (Nasdaq 100 E-mini) position size in contracts based on account balance, risk % and stop-loss. Built for prop firm and SMC/ICT traders.
- Intro: The NQ (E-mini Nasdaq 100) pays $20 per point per contract. Enter your account balance, risk percentage and stop-loss, and this tool instantly returns the exact number of NQ contracts to trade — keeping your risk inside prop firm drawdown limits.
- Contract specs: tick value $20 per point, position unit contracts, price precision 2 decimals. Realistic pre-fill: entry 19850, stop 19700, take-profit 20150.
- Keywords: NQ calculator, Nasdaq 100 position size, NQ risk calculator, prop firm NQ.
